title: Fort Témiscamingue Carpentry Workshop

terrainReference.basis: Original present-day terrain beside the estimated western threshold.

mapIdentity.provider: Parks Canada archaeological site inventory and mapped trading-post context
mapIdentity.scope: Quebec’s archaeological inventory locates the shop immediately west of the second forge. The modern mapped reconstruction west of the forge supplies a bounded estimate for the position and alignment.

note: Roy identifies the carpenter’s workshop as building 8 in the 1888 plan. The current rectangle and the Qualla view give approximate scale and overall timber appearance. The workshop doorway, light windows and small chimney are interpreted.
